title: mvrx.1: Fix Nucleo WL55JC Renode overlay — add STM32WL sub-GHz radio device node
description: Nucleo WL55JC gateway build fails at link because lichen_hal_lora_device_get references __device_dts_ord_87 which doesn't exist in the Renode overlay. The STM32WL has an integrated sub-GHz radio. Add the radio device node to the Renode .repl/.resc so the device tree ordinal resolves. Reference the Zephyr STM32WL DTS for the correct node path.
